facts.ROLE: Speed + gather — the team's pace and appetite engine

kit.name: Hella Maw
fields: Effect (canon): eat radius and chomp speed up — "the vacuum mouth the arcade was built on."
Delivery: self-buff / aura class (the maw itself), VS grammar.
Cost / cooldown (DRAFT convention): Energy 10 · cd 2.5s class.
Through the pipeline: scales with Ability Power (+10.8% → +93.0%) and, for its chomp-speed half, his attack-speed multiplier (×1.0 — he files no attack-speed points; the buff is the only source).
Numbers — eat-radius increase %, chomp-speed increase %, duration: GAP (the effect is canon; no magnitude is filed anywhere).
Rank-up axis spend: GAP (law exists, §30; his spend unfiled).

kit.name: Arcade Engine
fields: Effect (canon): +1 size step AND a speed surge, together — "bigger AND faster, the two buffs married." The marriage is the point: the general size law (DESIGN.md brainstorm layer) trades size against speed; this ability is the filed exception.
Cost / cooldown (DRAFT convention): Energy 25 · cd in the Rare band (8–10s class in SKILLS-ELEMENTS examples) — his exact cooldown: GAP.
Numbers — speed-surge %, stack cap, per-stack duration: GAP.

kit.name: (M) Transform
fields: Effect (canon): shifts form on the mythic dial — "the huge form and its kin" — size-class changing mid-run. Also filed as his equivalent (his car-equivalent: he has no car; the form shift is what he has instead — STAT-OUT #2, DRAFT field).
Cost (DRAFT convention): Energy 50 (mythic burst envelope). Cooldown: GAP (mythic class runs 55–60s in SKILLS-ELEMENTS examples; his is unfiled).

Socketing: as a mythic, Transform can socket a stone (canon, FULL-SCOPE §41). His aligned stone: POWER → Speciality (§41 stone alignment) — socketed, a stone pays +15% to its own slice's skills (BALANCE §9B, DRAFT).

THE 13 VARIABLES (canon §37: "Mythics carry VARIABLES — 13 of them; a mythic is tuned by its variables, not just ranked"): the count is canon; no file names the 13 variables — all 13 names and values: GAP. This is the single largest hole in the package.

Rank-up axis spend: GAP. Elemental skills held (SKILLS-ELEMENTS.md): none filed — his kit is character kit, not an elemental set; SKILLS-ELEMENTS names no Pac holder. Not a GAP in his kit (his 3 are above); recorded so nobody goes looking. ---

superUnique.name: Cast-Iron Stomach
text: Canon rule (ROSTER.md, owner-dictated; restated STAT-OUT #2, DESIGN-ghosts §5): Pure Pac RESISTS the bad edibles — their effects are blunted on him, and eating junk grants him BUFFS instead. He is the one character who can run DENIAL for free: eat a fiending ghost's drug in front of it and the ghost starves into withdrawal while Pac takes the high himself, tuned to Pac (DESIGN-ghosts §5 — "the economy's kingpin").
Filed case — cocaine: FILED: he takes the high himself, tuned to Pac — he redlines without the whittle (DESIGN-ghosts §5). The drain does not land; the surge does.

blueOrb: Look: an inverted eclipse — dark core, radiant corona, radiating energy, definitely BLUE.
On eating one: his character INVERTS and the screen inverts; enemies FLEE; the ghosts SCATTER outward, panic-dispersed, before the hunt begins (§24).

His expression of the surge: he GROWS in size (≥ 1 size step) and gets EXTRA CHOMPY — where other characters' orb buff speaks their language (extra quick, extra strong, quicker cooldowns), Pac's speaks appetite: size and chomp. This is also the Stage-1 teaching beat (eat the big blue one → EAT MODE → first skill).
EAT MODE: frightened ghosts are edible; the chain pays 200 / 400 / 800 / 1600 per ghost in sequence (game canon).
